policy.kind: local lab, no live or field measurements
policy.server: gzip text; max-age=600 assets and no-cache HTML; cold and same-context repeat navigation to identical URL
policy.fonts: real Google Fonts network requests allowed for performance; blocked in isolated accessibility cases
policy.analytics: all Google Analytics and Tag Manager requests blocked
policy.constrained: 4x CPU slowdown, 150 ms request latency, 1.6 Mbps download, 0.75 Mbps upload
caveats: HTTP cache policy is an explicit lab policy, not verified production headers.
Initial viewport LCP and CLS are observation-window values, not field p75.
Synthetic search latency is not INP.
Two samples per condition identify candidates; they do not establish reliable percentile claims.
